- **Cole Haan Women's Melrose Wedge Sandal** – $129.88, rated 4.3/5 from 8 reviews. Cole Haan is known for craftsmanship and style; this wedge sandal bridges dressy and everyday wear.
- **Cole Haan Men's Grnd Plus Essex Wedgechukka Chukka Boot** – $129.59, rated 4.6/5 from 35 reviews. Offers elegance and comfort with sneaker-like feel—pairs easily with jeans or business-casual looks.

But, I can work with that.  When you open the box, the wonderful smell of leather is the first thing that hits you.  I gently put them on.  All I can say is - Wow !!  They are definitely worth the price.  If you have a chance to buy these - Buy Them !!!  You will not be sorry !!

top_reviews.title: True to size
top_reviews.text: Used these boots and I received many compliments.

top_reviews.title: Narrow
top_reviews.text: I absolutely love these boots but sadly had to return them because they are very narrow. I do not have a wide foot but could not even get my foot into this boot because of the narrow width.
